name: What is the difference between a prefabricated shower kit and a custom tile shower?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a prefabricated shower kit and a custom tile shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prefabricated shower units are made of molded acrylic or fiberglass, making them cost-effective, fast to install, and very low-maintenance because they lack grout lines. Custom tile showers require a greater investment and longer installation time, but they offer complete design flexibility, fit any custom dimension, and deliver high aesthetic appeal. Tile requires ongoing grout maintenance and sealing to prevent mildew, while prefab units are limited to standard factory sizes and configurations. Choosing between them comes down to balancing your renovation budget, design goals, and routine cleaning preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prefab units install quickly, cost less, and lack grout lines, while custom tile offers bespoke styling and flexible sizing but demands more labor and maintenance.
